headline: Strategic European bet adds to earnings muscles

highlights: Evos reported CY25 EBITDA of EUR219mn with a margin of 56%, supported by 99% commercial occupancy, long-term contracted revenues and strong cash conversion.
We view the acquisition positively, given Evos' high-margin operations and strategic presence across key European energy hubs.

The addition of Evos should strengthen ADSEZ's international earnings contribution and improve its international ports EBITDA margin profile, while providing opportunities for growth through higher-value products, operating efficiencies and capacity addition in future.
While the debt-funded acquisition will increase leverage in the near term, Evos' contracted revenues and strong cash generation should support gradual deleveraging.
valuation: Overall, we believe the transaction strengthens ADSEZ's long-term growth prospects, with relatively lower valuation and execution pedigree.

Evos adds high-margin liquid storage platform ADSEZ has entered into an agreement to acquire a 100% stake in Netherlands-based Evos B.V. from Igneo Infrastructure Partners for an EV of EUR2.56bn (11.7x CY25 EV/EBITDA).

Exhibit 7: ADSEZ and EVO’s consolidated debt profile (Target net debt to EBITDA 2.5x by FY27) Source: Company Consolidated net debt/EBITDA to increase to ~2.76x following the acquisition, before moderating towards ~2.5x.
watch: We view the acquisition positively, given Evos' high-margin operations and strategic presence across key European energy hubs.
The key monitorables will be financing costs, integration, cash flow generation and the pace of deleveraging.
